metadata.settings: Simulation baseline: 30 FPS, disjoint modeled inference/contact durations, wired output; all allowance values are scenario assumptions
metadata.accuracy_evidence: Accuracy is outside this timing simulation; failed attempts are retained if supplied

frame_wait_rationale: Illustrative random arrival independent of nominal camera frames; excludes exposure and buffering
nonoverlap_rationale: Synthetic disjoint inference and contact-processing durations; real runs must establish boundaries before adding stages
software_coverage: Synthetic per-attempt inference and synchronous detection; allowance covers asynchronous contact history and omitted dispatch work

camera_capture.rationale: Scenario assumption: 8 ms exposure/buffering/delivery beyond frame phase, swept over 4-16 ms; chosen for sensitivity, not fitted hardware data

contact_gating.rationale: Scenario assumption: 5 ms asynchronous contact/scheduling/dispatch work, swept over 2-10 ms; longer temporal gates require a separate scenario

audio_output.rationale: Scenario assumption: 6 ms wired worklet/envelope/device output allowance, swept over 3-12 ms; excludes Bluetooth scenario
